fact: On 3 November 2026 (extraordinary session, reported 4 November 2026) the council of Lambanyi urban commune discussed a census of all taxpayers and digitalisation of all its revenue services, targeting 30 billion GNF in revenue in 2027.
title: Recensement des contribuables et digitalisation : la nouvelle offensive de la mairie de Lambanyi pour renflouer ses caisses
